# Expression

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Expression>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A realization of a [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) in a specific language, script, notation, or arrangement. The original-language text, a translation, and an audiobook narration are distinct Expressions of one [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md). The realizing language/notation is carried as a reference frame ([`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](../properties/gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)), not as a subclass. Identity changes when the language, notation, or arrangement differs.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

```turtle

#     translation is not a lesser version, just another Expression).

    gmeow:realizes ex:novel .

ex:frenchText a gmeow:Expression ;
    gmeow:realizes ex:novel .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when the LANGUAGE, script, notation, or arrangement is what distinguishes this realization from the abstract [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) — a translation, an audiobook narration, a score-versus-recording rendition; one tier below [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md), one above [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the language-neutral abstract creation (that is [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)) and for an edition/format/release (that is [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) — a paperback is not a new [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md) unless its text differs); carry the realizing language as a frame, never as a subclass ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Link to the [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) with [`gmeow:realizes`](../properties/gmeow-realizes.md), declare the realizing language/notation with [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](../properties/gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) (required-frame, P11), and let editions hang below via [`gmeow:embodiedIn`](../properties/gmeow-embodiedIn.md); for music set [`gmeow:realizationMode`](../properties/gmeow-realizationMode.md) rather than splitting into notated/performed subclasses.

### Examples

- ex:hamletGermanTranslation a [`gmeow:Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md); [`gmeow:realizes`](../properties/gmeow-realizes.md) ex:hamlet; [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](../properties/gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) ex:germanLanguage.
